products.name: Epic AI (SlicerDicer, etc.)
products.note: Clinical decision support; patient data exposure; HIPAA critical; FDA SaMD considerations

profile_text.body:
Epic Systems is a healthcare software company founded in 1979, headquartered in Verona, Wisconsin. The company describes itself as developing software to help people get well, stay well, and help future generations be healthier, with the patient positioned as central to its work.

Epic's AI offerings are integrated into its clinical and patient-facing products. On the clinical side, the company offers AI-supported outpatient office visit tools described as helping clinicians arrive prepared, anticipating needs during the visit, and lining up documentation and orders for review before the visit ends. A product called Chart with Art provides AI-assisted nursing documentation, and nurses at Mount Sinai Medical Center are described as the first in Florida to adopt it. For patients, an AI assistant called Emmie is available within Epic's MyChart platform, offering a conversational interface for understanding personal health information. The site tracks these capabilities under the product category of Epic AI, which also includes SlicerDicer, a clinical decision support tool, with noted considerations around patient data exposure, HIPAA compliance, and FDA software-as-a-medical-device classification.

No litigation or regulatory filings are recorded in the held facts for Epic Systems at this time.
